protocol.calibration: fixed temperatures and thresholds from the frozen bundle
protocol.feature_history: shared build_batch; full game chunks; same PA/side/previous pitches; no augmentation
protocol.common_row_mask: valid state and identity; known pitch type; one of five supported outcomes
protocol.zone_and_conditional_mask: common rows with a recorded zone
protocol.result_baseline_projection: frozen seven-class count tables conditioned on the same five result labels
protocol.baseline_zone: as in week two: both frequency baselines mix frozen pitcher/type zone estimates using their respective pitch probabilities
protocol.baseline_conditional_result: frozen count/pitch/zone result_action table, alpha30 and frozen count-result prior; same for both baselines
protocol.ece: 15 equal-width confidence bins, top-label absolute calibration error
protocol.conformal: 1-p <= frozen threshold; no threshold fitting or correction on final test

limitations: Final test is a retrospective 2025 regular-season cohort, not a future-performance guarantee.
Temporal drift and correlated pitches can invalidate exchangeability assumptions; nominal 90% is not guaranteed.
All-supported metrics include unseen player IDs with frozen unknown-ID features; the public API accepts only the frozen catalog. Catalog-serving metrics are reported separately.
Hit-by-pitch and other outcomes outside the five-class task are excluded and counted. Missing zones mask only zone and conditional-result evaluation.
Recorded pitch location is an observed outcome, not the intended target. Conditional-result accuracy on observed actions does not establish causal recommendation benefit.
Calibration-audit versus final-test changes compare different time cohorts; they do not isolate the cause of drift.
Frozen model metadata retains test_evaluated=false as historical training provenance; this separate report records the later final evaluation.
